messages:
marta: heads-up — customer 'atria' reporting 403 on SSO after idp cert rotation last night. only fails when hitting our CDN domain; direct origin login works. opening an SR.

ryan: ticket? repro steps?

marta: ticket #54321. repro: user clicks login -> idp redirect -> saml POST back to https://login.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs -> 403. our logs show 'SAMLRecipientMismatch' and 'signature invalid' but only when Accept-Encoding: br is present. curl without br succeeds.

anya: edge team rolled out brotli for that domain at ~02:10 UTC on staging. could compression be touching the POST body somehow?

ryan: saml response is base64 form data in the POST body — edge shouldn't compress POSTs. can you paste headers + the server log snippet?

marta: ```
Request headers:
Host: login.redwood-inference.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept-Encoding: br, gzip
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 4820

Server log:
[saml] verify_signature: failed: canonicalization mismatch (expected UTF-8,no-bom) at verify.go:213
[saml] recipient_check: mismatch against configured ACS list
```

support-bot: Ticket 54321 updated — assigned to eng-runtime. SLA: P2.

anya: quick lab test: disabled brotli for that hostname and enabled preserve-host on the edge. customer confirmed login immediately worked. so two leads: brotli interfering with body/hash OR host header rewrite causing ACS URL mismatch (idp metadata expects exact ACS URL without trailing slash/port).

ryan: looked at the idp metadata we have on file — it lists two ACS entries: one with trailing slash and one without. also the idp rotated certs and the metadata still references the old intermediary chain in one copy. multiple moving parts.

marta: plan of action: 1) rollback brotli for the production hostname 2) enable preserve-host pass-through on the edge 3) ask idp to refresh metadata and include full cert chain 4) add extra logging to capture Content-Encoding + body-hash when saml verifies. i'll communicate to customer and keep ticket updated.

anya: :thumbsup: i'll schedule the edge rollback now and add a short integration test to normalize ACS URLs when matching signed assertions.

ryan: i'll add a temporary log tag to trace requests that hit the ACS handler and include the body hash so we can prove if the bytes changed in transit.

marta: thanks — updating ticket. will do a follow-up postmortem once resolved.
